name: 402-checkout
description: A storefront with three working payment rails: Stripe card and native Hedera USDC on one MPP 402, and x402 beside it.

steps.text: Payments settle with native Hedera services. No contract deploy is required to run this template.
The store runs with no credentials at all. Each payment rail switches on independently when you add its keys.

steps.label: Browse the demo
steps.text: Open http://127.0.0.1:3000 and go through checkout. Every rail renders in demo mode until you configure it.

steps.label: Enable Hedera USDC
steps.text: Set HEDERA_OPERATOR_ID and HEDERA_OPERATOR_KEY in packages/nextjs/.env to settle real testnet payments.

steps.label: Enable card payments
steps.text: Set STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY and STRIPE_NETWORK_ID to accept cards through the same 402 challenge.

steps.label: Enable x402
steps.text: Set AX402_FACILITATOR_URL to compare the x402 flow against MPP on the same store.

steps.label: Read the comparison
steps.text: docs/mpp-vs-x402.md explains how the two protocols differ against an identical checkout.
